basic_info.description: This 3 story home just north of Cortland is the forever home you've been waiting for! ~ 2500 sft, 5BDRs/3.5BAs, a family room and much more! Taken to the studs and redesigned as the owner's primary residence in 2015, the home's coveted floor plan is ideal for family living and entertaining. Foyer w coat closet, space for hanging backpacks, and ample room to welcome guests. Spacious LR w soaring ceilings, lined w windows and b'ful custom built-in shelving. Light-filled KIT and dining spaces flow together punctuated by sweeping Bay views, and open to a spacious deck overlooking the Bay. Pro, skylit KIT w generous Calacatta marble island, SubZero refrigerator, Wolf range, a 2nd built-in Wolf oven, Miele dishwasher, and Caesarstone counters. Designer powder rm + dream laundry room w sink and Uline wine fridge. Upstairs the ideal layout: 3BDR/2BAs. King bed primary looks directly at the Bay w 2 full closets, and an ensuite marble BA. Downstairs at the garden, 2 add'l BDRs  home office, guest space, au pair quarters  a full tiled BA, and a sumptuous family room opens to the garden. Garage parking. Air conditioning throughout, newer plumbing, electrical, foundation, and more. 90 WalkScore - a 'Walkers Paradise' -steps to Black Jet bakery and the village. Rare find, do not miss!
